Initialization
===
```{r, message=FALSE}
# devtools::install_github("amehtaSF/rsurveyutils")
library(rsurveyutils)
library(qualtRics)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(lmerTest)
library(sjPlot)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```


Preprocessing
===

Read data
---
```{r}
filepath <- sprintf("%s/precision_reap_bot_react_feb2025.csv", recent_date_dir(here("analysis/data/raw")))
df_qualtrics_file <- read_survey(here(filepath))


df_conversations_file <- read_csv(here("analysis/conversations.csv"))
df_analysis_data_file <- read_csv(here("analysis/analysis_data.csv"))
df_messages_file <- read_csv(here("analysis/messages.csv"))
df_llm_queries_file <- read_csv(here("analysis/llm_queries.csv"))

```

```{r}
# remove_convo_ids <- c(
#   207,
#   210
# )
```


```{r}

df_qualtrics <- df_qualtrics_file %>% 
  filter(use_survey == "Yes") %>% 
  filter(use_survey_values == "Yes") %>% 
  filter(use_survey_issue == "Yes") %>% 
  rename(
    ai_general = Q22_1,
    ai_emo = Q23_1,
    secret_word = Q4,
    bot_enjoy = bot_enjoy_1,
    bot_reuse = bot_reuse_1,
    bot_helpful = bot_helpful_1,
  ) %>% 
  filter(!duplicated(pid))

df_qualtrics %>%
  filter(pid %in% (df_qualtrics %>%
                    group_by(pid) %>%
                    filter(n() > 1) %>%
                    summarize(n = n()) %>%
                    filter(n > 1) %>%
                    pull(pid)
           )) %>%
  view
  
  
df_conversations <- df_conversations_file %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(pid, "test")) %>% 
  filter(pid %in% df_qualtrics_file$pid) %>%
  rename(convo_id = id) %>% 
  filter(state == "COMPLETE") %>% 
  arrange(ymd_hms(created_at)) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(pid))

df_messages <- df_messages_file %>% 
  filter(convo_id %in% df_conversations$convo_id) %>% 
  left_join(df_conversations %>% select(convo_id, pid)) 

df_conversations %>% nrow

df_analysis <- df_analysis_data_file %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(created_at, updated_at), ymd_hms) %>%
  # keep participants i kept in convo df
  filter(convo_id %in% df_conversations$convo_id) %>% 
  # replace erroneous NAs with 0
  mutate(content = ifelse(str_detect(field, "rate_") & is.na(content), "0", content)) %>% 
  # remove duplicate rows
  group_by(convo_id, field) %>%
  arrange(created_at) %>% 
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  # add pid
  left_join(df_conversations %>% select(convo_id, pid)) 

df_analysis %>% 
  group_by(pid) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))
  
  
df_analysis_w <- df_analysis %>% 
  select(convo_id, field, content) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = field, values_from = content) %>% 
  mutate(reap_ranks_og = reap_ranks) %>% 
  mutate(reap_ranks = str_replace_all(reap_ranks, "\\[|\\]|\"| ", "")) %>% 
  # separate reap ranks by comma into place1_idx, place2_idx, place3_idx, place4_idx
  separate_wider_delim(reap_ranks, 
                       delim = ",", 
                       names = c("place1_idx", "place2_idx", "place3_idx", "place4_idx"),
                       too_few = "debug"
                       ) %>% 
  filter(as.numeric(place1_idx) <= 4) %>% 
  filter(as.numeric(place2_idx) <= 4) %>% 
  filter(as.numeric(place3_idx) <= 4) %>% 
  filter(as.numeric(place4_idx) <= 4) %>% 
  mutate(
    top1_rank = case_when(
      reap_top1_idx == place1_idx ~ 1,
      reap_top1_idx == place2_idx ~ 2,
      reap_top1_idx == place3_idx ~ 3,
      reap_top1_idx == place4_idx ~ 4
    ),
    top2_rank = case_when(
      reap_top2_idx == place1_idx ~ 1,
      reap_top2_idx == place2_idx ~ 2,
      reap_top2_idx == place3_idx ~ 3,
      reap_top2_idx == place4_idx ~ 4
    ),
    bottom1_rank = case_when(
      reap_bottom1_idx == place1_idx ~ 1,
      reap_bottom1_idx == place2_idx ~ 2,
      reap_bottom1_idx == place3_idx ~ 3,
      reap_bottom1_idx == place4_idx ~ 4
    ),
    bottom2_rank = case_when(
      reap_bottom2_idx == place1_idx ~ 1,
      reap_bottom2_idx == place2_idx ~ 2,
      reap_bottom2_idx == place3_idx ~ 3,
      reap_bottom2_idx == place4_idx ~ 4
    ),
  ) %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(rate_issue_pos, rate_issue_neg), as.numeric) 
df_ranks <- df_analysis_w %>% 
  select(convo_id, top1_rank, top2_rank, bottom1_rank, bottom2_rank) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(top1_rank, top2_rank, bottom1_rank, bottom2_rank), 
               names_to = "reap_type", 
               names_pattern = "(top|bottom).*",
               values_to = "rank") 


```

Export
===

```{r}
write_csv(df_qualtrics, here("analysis/data/proc/df_qualtrics.csv"))
write_csv(df_conversations, here("analysis/data/proc/df_conversations.csv"))
write_csv(df_analysis, here("analysis/data/proc/df_analysis.csv"))
write_csv(df_analysis_w, here("analysis/data/proc/df_analysis_w.csv"))
write_csv(df_ranks, here("analysis/data/proc/df_ranks.csv"))
write_csv(df_messages, here("analysis/data/proc/df_messages.csv"))

```
